source_name: PIB Fact Check, Press Information Bureau, Govt of India ('Screenshots of day-wise fact checks done by Fact Check Unit', linked from pib.gov.in/factcheck.aspx)
text:
CP-BRDOTP
Tuesday, 24 August 2021
Hi Customer, your A/c ***7865 Credited for Rs 267000 on 24-08-2021 Under Govt Yojana Ap[…]ed click https[…] bit.ly/3[…] BT
notes: Fake 'Govt Yojana' credit SMS leading to a phishing link; the first line is the sender header. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
